description.en: Sets the position (and, for 3D characters, Y rotation) of a handle. Accepts either a 3-element [x, y, z] array (used for 2D elements like images/bust-ups) or four separate x, y, z, rotation arguments (used for 3D characters).
Either a [x, y, z] array, or the X coordinate when passing x/y/z/rotation separately.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).
